text: What the team has built, tested and identified for field review.
The supervisor dashboard runs on Cloudflare Workers. A Hono API written in TypeScript stores crews and help acknowledgements in D1.
Automated domain, API and browser checks cover crew privacy and help response. The repository includes the hardware design and pilot plan.
The Android and watch connection is simulated. Next steps are hardware qualification, Android background BLE testing, occupational-health and local-language review, and site recruitment.

text: How a worker’s help request reaches the supervisor, and where the record is kept.

Hono / TypeScript
Site access and alerts

Routine: groups of ≥3.
Named identity: help only.
ACK does not clear help.
notes: The worker requests help on the watch. The shared Android gateway queues the request and forwards it to the site API. The supervisor acknowledges receipt, and D1 keeps the request and acknowledgement. Routine crew summaries require three contributors. Clothing and acclimatization settings stay on the watch.

text: Initial use case: outdoor construction crews in the Accra area, Ghana.
See today’s and tomorrow’s heat windows, check crew-level status and plan heavier tasks, breaks and rotation.
Receive simple graded warnings and request help without requiring every worker to own a smartphone.
Carry the shared Android phone, check device readiness and follow the site’s existing emergency procedure.
Earlier recognition and clearer action, with routine individual exposure kept out of the supervisor view.
Construction first. Logistics and commercial farms require separate site and worker validation.
notes: The primary dashboard role is supervisor; crew lead and responder are operational responsibilities, not extra analytics portals. Ghana is the proposed first setting, not a confirmed pilot partner or exclusive market. English is currently implemented; Twi or another language requires worker-led selection and fluent-speaker review. Intended benefits are hypotheses: no measured reduction in illness, injury or lost work is claimed. Source context: WHO/WMO [1]; prevention actions: NIOSH [2,3].

text: Proposed acceptance criteria and pilot measures, not reported field outcomes.
notes: Target p95 ≤2 seconds is the project’s proposed healthy-network backend-to-dashboard target (PRD section 13), not a measured achieved value and not end-to-end offline radio latency. At least 20 runs are required. Log p50/p95 and missed/duplicate denominators. A separate weak-link cold render target is ≤5s p95 under 400kbps down/100kbps up/400ms RTT plus an outage. These targets are not yet established by the recorded browser checks. Pilot false alarms need an expert-reviewed reference definition, not app-generated labels. Exposure and incident rates require worker-hours / work context and a prospective protocol. Rest adherence is an observation/research measure, not an implemented productivity tracker. No safety control may be withheld for evaluation.

text: External evidence motivates the design; software checks establish only software behaviour.
workers worldwide are exposed to excessive heat, according to WHO and WMO, citing ILO [1].
NIOSH recommends acclimatization, hydration, rest, training and supervision.
Checks used generated scenarios. Field reliability, clinical accuracy and health outcomes remain unverified.
notes: [1] WHO/WMO news release, 22 August 2025, verified 20 November 2026. It reports >2.4 billion exposed workers and attributes estimates to ILO. No Ghana-specific prevalence or project-specific effect size is inferred. [2] NIOSH Criteria, 2016 publication 2016-106. [3] Current NIOSH workplace recommendations verified 20 November 2026. [7] Existing released/reference evidence: 72 Python tests; 16 deployed-domain tests; 27 local Chromium workflow assertions. Earlier hosted version passed 25 browser checks; counts are different test runs, not 115 independent requirements or a clinical trial. The 48 planned acceptance cases are not all signed off. Working-tree operational extensions have additional unit checks but lack a complete released integration run; omitted from this proof claim. Do not present simulated fault injection as physical field testing.

text: Data sources and legal right to use them
Data minimization applies across ingestion, storage, browser access and future device provisioning.
notes: Open-Meteo terms and licence pages were directly verified on 20 November 2026: https://open-meteo.com/en/terms and https://open-meteo.com/en/licence. Distinguish the CC BY 4.0 data licence from the Free API’s non-commercial service restriction. Attribution and change indications must be retained; underlying-provider conditions should be checked. Commercial use or higher volume requires a suitable subscription or self-hosted arrangement. No third-party personal dataset, pretrained clinical model or claimed patient-data consent is used. Any real pilot requires a Ghana Act 843 review, controller/processor allocation, registration obligations where applicable, lawful basis, purpose limitation, worker information, retention and cross-border-hosting review. A three-person threshold is an engineering safeguard, not proof of anonymization or legal compliance. Personal setup/response identity remains personal data even when routine summaries are aggregated.

text: Human safety decisions remain with workers, site responders and the supervisor.
notes: Currently implemented safeguards include scope checks, bounded allowlisted requests, session protections, no-store protected responses, non-overlapping groups, count suppression and receipt semantics. Hardware autonomy, phone outbox hop receipts, credential lifecycle, production identity integration, retention/deletion automation and full security assurance remain development/pilot gates. Do not claim a formal security audit, medical-device certification or clinical validation. Acknowledging receipt must never resolve an active worker help state. Reconnection must not reset the sample time of old data. Red is preserved under uncertainty. On the radio/power failure path, no software queue can guarantee immediate offline delivery. Worker consent does not by itself resolve employment power imbalance or every legal basis.

text: Indicative sequence after submission, dependent on people, equipment and approvals.
Sustainability hypothesis: site subscription + maintained devices. Validate willingness to pay, supplier costs and paid weather access.
notes: No pilot partner, clinician, worker representative, ethics approval or supplier commitment is secured by this document. Proposed sequence, not booked dates. Site permission, appropriate institutional ethics determination, Ghana Act 843/DPC obligations, controller/processor agreements, cross-border hosting and intended-use/device classification review are prerequisites where applicable. Begin in shadow mode; never increase heat exposure, withhold controls or delay care to test Exaclim. A small feasibility study cannot establish reduced heat illness. Scale only after reliability, worker acceptability, equitable access and site response capacity are demonstrated. Commercial use needs a viable maintenance/support model and appropriate weather-service access. Do not reuse the old station/two-badge allowance as a final price per worker.
